description: Unofficial Kurisu Makise fan-art companion from Steins;Gate. Original animation shows a sealed harmless sample tube, notebook diagrams and a phone call with a tie adjustment, plus a page mishap, three articulated running directions and a small jump. Her familiar auburn hair, brown jacket, opaque shirt, dark shorts over full tights and closed boots are stylized with simplified seams; no official animation, worldline costume or endorsement is claimed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
